vulnerabilities.evidence: Lines 29-31 in transfer() and lines 46-50 in transferFrom()

execution.state_issue: Rounding errors in token distribution can cause loss of tokens.
execution.exploitable_behavior: The contract may permanently lose tokens due to rounding.

causality.state: The token distribution calculation does not handle fractional tokens properly.
causality.guard: No explicit guard against non-integer values after division.
causality.transition: Incorrect handling of token distribution leads to loss.
causality.capability: An attacker can exploit rounding errors to lose tokens.
causality.outcome: Permanent loss of tokens due to rounding.
